tools.name: nxtl_account_summary
tools.description: Use this when the signed-in customer asks for their NXTL balance or an account summary. Read only.

tools.name: nxtl_list_esims
tools.description: Use this when the signed-in customer asks about their NXTL eSIMs, or before looking at one eSIM’s status or usage. Never returns activation or QR codes. Read only.

tools.name: nxtl_esim_status
tools.description: Use this when the signed-in customer asks whether their NXTL eSIM is working, why it has no data, or which network it is on. Returns what NXTL has recorded (last connection, network, country, 4G/5G, data today). Cannot see the phone’s settings or signal. Read only.

tools.name: nxtl_usage_history
tools.description: Use this when the signed-in customer asks how much data one of their eSIMs used over some days. Up to 31 days per call, by session or by day. Read only.

tools.name: nxtl_destination_rates
tools.description: Use this when someone asks what mobile data costs in a country with NXTL, or which networks NXTL uses there. Returns NXTL’s per-GB rate for each partner network. Signed out it shows published rates; signed in it shows this account’s own rates. Does not buy or reserve anything.

tools.name: nxtl_installation_guidance
tools.description: Use this when the signed-in customer needs help installing or re-installing one of their eSIMs. Never returns activation or QR codes. Read only.

tools.name: nxtl_usage_limits
tools.description: Use this when the signed-in customer asks about their spending limits on the account or one eSIM. Read only.

tools.name: nxtl_account_capabilities
tools.description: Use this when the customer asks what this assistant can and cannot do with their NXTL account.

tools.name: nxtl_membership_benefits
tools.description: Use this when the signed-in customer asks what their Premium or Founder status gives them. Read only.

tools.name: nxtl_knowledge
tools.description: Use this for how-to and policy questions about NXTL: installing the eSIM, roaming settings, APN, top-ups, balance rules, hotspot, moving the eSIM to a new phone, troubleshooting. Returns NXTL’s verified help text. No prices and no account data.

tools.name: nxtl_site_search
tools.description: Use this when a page on nxtlsim.com (NXTL’s own website) would answer the question: country guides, coverage, compatible devices, set-up guides, FAQ, policies. Returns up to five pages with a link and excerpt. Public pages only.

tools.name: nxtl_site_page
tools.description: Use this to read one public page of nxtlsim.com (NXTL’s own website), found with the site search or a known path such as /esim-setup/. Account and payment pages are not readable. Prices in page text may be out of date; use the rate tools for current rates.

tools.name: nxtl_account_links
tools.description: Use this when the signed-in customer asks where to find something in their NXTL account on nxtlsim.com. Returns links to their account pages. Read only.

tools.name: nxtl_auto_topup_status
tools.description: Use this when the signed-in customer asks whether auto top-up is on, and its threshold and amount. Read only.

tools.name: nxtl_currencies
tools.description: Use this when someone asks which currencies NXTL shows or bills in.

tools.name: nxtl_support
tools.description: Use this when the person wants to contact NXTL or find NXTL help pages.

tools.name: nxtl_orders
tools.description: Use this when the signed-in customer asks whether a payment went through, or for an invoice. Returns their orders with status and invoice links. Read only.

tools.name: nxtl_balance_activity
tools.description: Use this when the signed-in customer asks why their balance changed, when they last topped up, or what they spent in a month. Returns balance history with amounts. Read only.

tools.name: nxtl_trip_data_estimate
tools.description: Use this when someone asks how much mobile data a trip needs, or what the data for a trip would cost with NXTL. Give each destination with its days and a usage level (light, everyday or heavy). Returns GB per day, total GB and a cost range from the lowest to the highest network rate. An estimate, no

tools.name: nxtl_device_check
tools.description: Use this when someone asks whether a phone, tablet, laptop or hotspot supports eSIM, or if it needs to be unlocked. Returns the status from NXTL’s reviewed device list and what to check. Cannot see the person’s own device.
